changeSet.author: foremen
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE bank_transaction_links ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, transaction_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, kind VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, amount NUMERIC(19,2) NOT NULL, worker_payout_id BIGINT REFERENCES worker_payouts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, procurement_document_id BIGINT REFERENCES procurement_documents (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, payment_schedule_id BIGINT REFERENCES payment_schedules (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, payment_transaction_id BIGINT REFERENCES payment_transactions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, project_id BIGINT REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, unplanned_category_id BIGINT REFERENCES unplanned_expense_categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, counter_account_id BIGINT REFERENCES bank_accounts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, source VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, confidence NUMERIC(4,3), confirmed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, confirmed_by VARCHAR(255), note TEXT, created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), created_by VARCHAR(255), updated_date TIMESTAMP, updated_by VARCHAR(255), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_transaction_links_amount_positive CHECK (amount > 0), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_transaction_links_kind CHECK (kind IN ( 'WORKER_PAYOUT', 'PROCUREMENT', 'CLIENT_PAYMENT', 'OTHER_EXPENSE', 'OTHER_INCOME', 'INTERNAL_TRANSFER' )), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_transaction_links_source CHECK (source IN ('RULE', 'AI', 'MANUAL')), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_transaction_links_confidence CHECK (confidence IS NULL OR (confidence >= 0 AND confidence <= 1)), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_transaction_links_kind_target CHECK ( (kind = 'WORKER_PAYOUT') = (worker_payout_id IS NOT NULL) AND (kind = 'PROCUREMENT' OR procurement_document_id IS NULL) AND (kind = 'CLIENT_PAYMENT') = (payment_schedule_id IS NOT NULL) AND (kind = 'CLIENT_PAYMENT' OR payment_transaction_id IS NULL) AND (kind = 'OTHER_EXPENSE') = (unplanned_category_id IS NOT NULL) AND (kind = 'INTERNAL_TRANSFER' OR counter_account_id IS NULL) ) ); CREATE INDEX ix_bank_transaction_links_transaction ON bank_transaction_links (transaction_id); CREATE INDEX ix_bank_transaction_links_payout ON bank_transaction_links (worker_payout_id); CREATE INDEX ix_bank_transaction_links_document ON bank_transaction_links (procurement_document_id); CREATE INDEX ix_bank_transaction_links_schedule ON bank_transaction_links (payment_schedule_id);

changeSet.author: foremen
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE bank_transaction_suggestions ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, transaction_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, kind VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, amount NUMERIC(19,2) NOT NULL, worker_payout_id BIGINT REFERENCES worker_payouts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, procurement_document_id BIGINT REFERENCES procurement_documents (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, payment_schedule_id BIGINT REFERENCES payment_schedules (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, project_id BIGINT REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, unplanned_category_id BIGINT REFERENCES unplanned_expense_categories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, counter_account_id BIGINT REFERENCES bank_accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, rank SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, rationale VARCHAR(300), status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN', source VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, confidence NUMERIC(4,3), note TEXT, created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), created_by VARCHAR(255), updated_date TIMESTAMP, updated_by VARCHAR(255), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_transaction_suggestions_amount_positive CHECK (amount > 0), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_transaction_suggestions_kind CHECK (kind IN ( 'WORKER_PAYOUT', 'PROCUREMENT', 'CLIENT_PAYMENT', 'OTHER_EXPENSE', 'OTHER_INCOME', 'INTERNAL_TRANSFER' )), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_transaction_suggestions_source CHECK (source IN ('RULE', 'AI', 'MANUAL')), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_transaction_suggestions_status CHECK (status IN ('OPEN', 'CONFIRMED', 'REJECTED', 'SUPERSEDED')), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_transaction_suggestions_confidence CHECK (confidence IS NULL OR (confidence >= 0 AND confidence <= 1)), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_transaction_suggestions_kind_target CHECK ( (kind = 'WORKER_PAYOUT') = (worker_payout_id IS NOT NULL) AND (kind = 'PROCUREMENT') = (procurement_document_id IS NOT NULL) AND (kind = 'CLIENT_PAYMENT') = (payment_schedule_id IS NOT NULL) AND (kind = 'OTHER_EXPENSE') = (unplanned_category_id IS NOT NULL) AND (kind = 'INTERNAL_TRANSFER' OR counter_account_id IS NULL) ) ); CREATE INDEX ix_bank_transaction_suggestions_transaction_status ON bank_transaction_suggestions (transaction_id, status);

changeSet.author: foremen
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE bank_counterparty_rules ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, counterparty_key VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, display_name VARCHAR(255), target_kind VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, worker_id BIGINT REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, supplier_name VARCHAR(255), supplier_nip VARCHAR(10), project_id BIGINT REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, payment_schedule_id BIGINT REFERENCES payment_schedules (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, unplanned_category_id BIGINT REFERENCES unplanned_expense_categories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, counter_account_id BIGINT REFERENCES bank_accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, hits INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_used_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, origin VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LEARNED', created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), created_by VARCHAR(255), updated_date TIMESTAMP, updated_by VARCHAR(255), CONSTRAINT uq_bank_counterparty_rules_key UNIQUE (counterparty_key), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_counterparty_rules_target_kind CHECK (target_kind IN ( 'WORKER_PAYOUT', 'PROCUREMENT', 'CLIENT_PAYMENT', 'OTHER_EXPENSE', 'OTHER_INCOME', 'INTERNAL_TRANSFER' )), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_counterparty_rules_origin CHECK (origin IN ('LEARNED', 'MANUAL')), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_counterparty_rules_hits CHECK (hits >= 0) );
